raw_text: Sagaing frontline update: PDF Battalion 7 and local Chinland Defence Force units have seized the Khampat checkpoint on the India-Myanmar border road. Junta airstrikes reported near Kalay. Approximately 5,000 IDPs moving towards Moreh crossing. Urgent need for humanitarian corridor. Indian Army strengthening Moreh-Tamu border post.
